Mr. Justice Wasim Sadiq Nargal, Judge

Order 
It has been brought to the notice of this court by Mr. Amit Gupta, learned AAG appearing on behalf of the respondent-Collector that the Collector has already initiated the process to pay the compensation to the rightful claimants under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Re-settlement Act, 2013 and he seeks six weeks further time to comply with the order dated 26.06.2013 passed by this Court in its letter and spirit.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Re-settlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Six weeks' further time is granted to the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the respondent-Collector to comply with the order/judgment passed by this Court dated 26.06.2013 in OWP No. 736/2013 and file fresh compliance report within the aforesaid period with an advance copy to the other side, who may respond to the same within one week thereafter.
Personal appearance of respondent No.1 (Dharam Pal) is dispensed with for the time being till further orders from the court.
